profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc. is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading under the ticker AMBA. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001280263. The company describes itself as a provider of AI vision processors for edge applications. Its website states that its advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting valuable data from high-resolution video streams.

The company's site lists target applications including advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles. It says Ambarella is committed to preparing customers for the road ahead.

California court records list 281 matters involving Ambarella Inc. No additional case details are provided.
